jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Project Manager & Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation 
 BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.
 Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.
 We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today. 
 
 Location

As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage remote team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by blp.
  
 About the role
 As a versatile professional with a passion for technology, you'll operate at the intersection of business and tech, leading end-to-end implementations of our Native-AI-powered ERP automation products. You'll help customers reimagine their processes, maximize automation rates, and turn their AI initiatives into measurable success.
 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take pride in driving results with full ownership, and want your work to have real business impact every single day, this role is made for you.
  
 What you'll do
 Own the implementation journey end-to-end, from understanding client requirements to ensuring smooth delivery, high customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

 Translate complexity into clarity: design scalable, tailored solutions that align with customer workflows and business goals.

 Collaborate closely with our engineering team to tackle technical challenges, adapt the system to customers' unique processes, and ensure successful integration with existing systems.

 Be the client's trusted partner: anticipate needs, surface insights, and ensure they realise the full potential of blp's automation.

 Work with sales to design tailored implementation plans aligned with customer needs and drive deep product adoption.

 What you'll bring
 Key attributes for success 
 Ownership and autonomy. You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver results end-to-end.

 Managing ambiguity. You stay calm and effective when information is incomplete or goals shift.

 Growth mindset. You learn fast, seek feedback, and use it to raise your game.

 Problem solving and critical thinking. You approach challenges systematically, using logic and evidence to make decisions.

 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field, or equivalent work experience.

 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

 Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 Proven ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple stakeholders.

 Strong analytical and communication skills: you can translate business needs into technical action.

 Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with and presenting to native-speaking clients.

 Experience with ERP environments or cutting-edge AI-driven SaaS solutions is a definite plus.

 Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) process flows is a strong advantage.

  
 What you'll get
 High ownership environment. You shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

 Impact at scale. Your work powers automation across global enterprises.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
jobs.description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
  • The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
  • A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Why join JetBrains?

jobs.title: AI Transformation Owner, Product & Design
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.

Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.

You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

What you'll do

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.
  • Map how work flows across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?
  • Manage intake of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.
  • Prioritize strategically against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.

Adoption & Change Management

  • Reimagine, not just automate. Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  • Drive adoption and change management together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise AI to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.
  • Build and bridge the Champion network in your function. Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Machine Learning
jobs.description:
The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.

The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change. 

One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines. 

That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.

Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.

Join us to help us build a more resilient world together. 

Role & Team

You’ll lead a core part of our Vegetation Intelligence, the product area that turns remote sensing imagery and data into the vegetation insights that utilities act on every day, through world-class machine learning models. It’s one of Overstory’s most foundational products, live with customers now, and it sits at the center of how we prevent outages and stop wildfires. Every missed tree is an outage or a fire that could have been prevented.

The job is twofold. One is real ML-adjacent work: pushing our detection models further and turning their raw outputs into risk data precise enough for customers to trust and act on. You’ll need to be comfortable with complex machine learning models and geospatial data, close to the data science and engineering teams, and fluent enough in model trade-offs to make good calls with data scientists and ML engineers.

The other side is where you get to build new capabilities: taking that same data and pushing it into new products and capabilities customers don't have yet. You'll run user research, ground new product bets in the decisions customers make in the field, and turn a strong model into products that prevent real fires and real outages.

You’ll report to the Director of Product and own the strategy and roadmap for this product area end to end.

Time Zone Requirement: Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST, CST) Comfortable maintaining 3-4 hours of overlap European working hours for collaboration with the broader Overstory team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap for Vegetation Intelligence, spanning from the ML models that produce our risk data to the products that turn it into customer action.
  • Push our detection models further, and help fold their outputs into Overstory’s broader outage and ignition risk models.
  • Contribute towards increasing the number of actionable insights: run user research, ground priorities in the operational decisions customers actually make, and make sure what we ship drives real action in the field.
  • Shift the roadmap from scaling- and technical-led to customer-driven, without losing the technical rigor that got us here.
  • Work closely with data scientists and ML engineers to turn model capability into shipped product value, and define what “good” looks like for a model in production.
  • Explore how feedback from customers and end users, like arborists, can improve model performance over time.
  • Communicate clearly and often with the broader product and engineering team, so trade-offs, model limits, and priorities stay visible.
  • Contribute to Overstory’s broader product strategy so Vegetation Insights supports where the rest of the product is headed

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record that proves both craft and shipping speed.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping products powered by machine learning models. You understand how models get built, trained, evaluated, and improved, and you can talk model performance and trade-offs directly with data scientists and ML engineers.
  • Experience turning a scaling- or technical-led roadmap into a customer-driven one, including runni

Tu participeras également aux réflexions stratégiques autour de l'initiative "SAP United" pour conseiller et étudier le déploiement de SAP HR dans d’autres pays, notamment avec le Royaume-Uni et la Malaisie en remplacement de leurs solutions locales.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Minimum 5 ans d'expérience sur un scope et des responsabilités similaires.
  • Expertise Métier : Une expérience significative sur un outil de paie et une forte appétence pour les enjeux techniques et légaux liés aux RH. Une connaissance de SAP HR est un sérieux atout.
  • Product Management & Agilité : Maîtrise de la méthodologie Agile (JIRA), vision orientée valeur produit, et capacité éprouvée à gérer des dépendances complexes et des roadmaps techniques.
  • Soft Skills : Excellente communication, leadership d'influence pour animer des tiers (éditeurs, intégrateurs) et collaborer avec des opérationnels experts. Esprit critique, orientation décisionnelle et forte capacité à prendre du recul.
  • Langues : Français & Anglais courant indispensable pour évoluer dans notre contexte international.

STACK TECHNIQUE

  • SAP HR & SAP BW HR
  • Environnement RISE S4
  • Écosystème SIRH (Workday, Etemptation) 
  • JIRA

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

jobs.title: Cloud Platform - Senior Digital Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
La Cloud Platform Engineering recherche un(e) Senior Digital Product Manager basé(e) à Lille.

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons qu’il est essentiel de rendre les joies et les bienfaits du sport accessibles à tous.

Pour y parvenir, nos équipes ont besoin d’un système d’information performant, évolutif et sécurisé. La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) contribue à cet enjeu en développant des produits et services internes qui simplifient la vie des équipes tech, accélèrent la livraison, renforcent la sécurité et améliorent la maîtrise des opérations et des coûts.

Au sein de cet écosystème, notre offre Cloud Platform s’appuie sur plusieurs produits complémentaires :

  • 3S (Self Service Stack), notre plateforme interne de self-service cloud principalement orientée GCP ;
  • Cloud Kraft, qui complète notre offre de plateforme sur les services non industrialisé dans la 3S ;
  • notre service managé sur AWS, destiné à accompagner les équipes ayant des besoins spécifiques sur cet environnement.

Ensemble, ces produits permettent aux équipes de provisionner, déployer, faire évoluer et opérer leurs assets cloud via une approche standardisée, industrialisée et documentée, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur la sécurité, la résilience, l’observabilité et la maîtrise des coûts.

Ta mission

En tant que Senior Digital Product Manager, tu pilotes l’évolution de notre portefeuille de produits Cloud Platform, avec un rôle central sur 3S, Cloud Kraft et notre offre de service managé AWS.

Ton rôle est de maximiser la valeur apportée aux équipes utilisatrices en améliorant :

  • la clarté de l’offre et son positionnement ;
  • la qualité de l’expérience développeur ;
  • l’adoption des composants et services de la plateforme ;
  • la cohérence produit entre provisioning, standards, documentation, accompagnement et intégration dans l’écosystème engineering de Decathlon.

Tu interviens au croisement du produit, de la plateforme et des usages, avec une forte sensibilité à la scalabilité, à la sécurité, à la standardisation, à l’observabilité et à la maîtrise des coûts.

Tes responsabilités

Vision et stratégie produit

  • Définir et porter la vision produit de notre offre Cloud Platform et de ses différentes briques.
  • Clarifier le positionnement, les promesses, les cas d’usage et les priorités de 3S, Cloud Kraft et du service managé AWS.
  • Faire évoluer l’offre en cohérence avec les besoins des équipes, les contraintes d’engineering et les tendances du marché cloud.

Discovery & connaissance utilisateur

  • Mener une discovery continue auprès des équipes engineering, plateforme, sécurité et produit.
  • Comprendre les irritants, les besoins réels et les arbitrages entre autonomie, sécurité, standardisation, time-to-market et coût.
  • Transformer les retours terrain en opportunités produit concrètes et priorisées.

Roadmap & delivery

  • Piloter une roadmap multi-produits, en lien étroit avec les équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Prioriser les évolutions en fonction de la valeur utilisateur, de l’impact business et des enjeux techniques.
  • Suivre l’exécution jusqu’à la mise à disposition effective des fonctionnalités et services.

Adoption, documentation et change

  • Améliorer l’intégration des produits dans les parcours engineering et dans l’IDP.
  • Porter une documentation claire, maintenable et orientée usage.
  • Accompagner l’adoption via la pédagogie, les formations, les rituels et l’évangélisation produit.

Mesure de la performance produit

  • Définir les KPIs de performance, d’adoption, de satisfaction et d’efficience.
  • Utiliser la donnée pour éclairer les décisions produit et soutenir les arbitrages d’investissement.
  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes concernées sur les enjeux FinOps et d’optimisation d’usage sur GCP comme sur AWS.

Ton profil

  • Expérience significative en Product Management sur un produit technique, une plateforme interne ou un environnement à forte dominante engineering.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Protocol)
jobs.description:
About Morpho
 Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.
  
 Why Morpho Exists
 Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here .
 Location
 Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).
  
 Role
 Morpho's Protocol team is evolving the core lending infrastructure that powers products and markets across the ecosystem. As the number of opportunities, integrations, and protocol initiatives grows, the team needs clear product direction on what to build, why it matters, and how to sequence the work. 
 
 This role will work with Morpho’s protocol team to shape product strategy and guide execution. You will turn the needs of users and ecosystem partners into a focused roadmap, work closely with protocol and engineering teams to shape solutions, and drive improvements from discovery through launch and adoption. You will operate at the intersection of deeply technical systems, financial markets, and a fast-moving ecosystem.
  
 Responsibilities
 Own the roadmap for Morpho's protocol team, defining the highest-impact problems to solve and sequencing opportunities against company goals, user needs, technical constraints, and ecosystem dynamics.

 Build and run a continuous discovery process with curators, distributors, integrators, developers, and other protocol users to understand their workflows, pain points, and emerging needs.

 Translate user and market insights into clear product requirements, decision frameworks, and success criteria that help protocol and engineering teams move quickly with strong rationale.

 Partner closely with protocol, engineering, research, security, legal, solutions, partnerships, and marketing to take initiatives from early exploration through design, implementation, audit, launch, and adoption.

 Evaluate product and technical tradeoffs, including when to extend the protocol, improve surrounding infrastructure, enable partners, or deliberately avoid adding complexity.

 Define and track the signals that show whether protocol initiatives are working, combining quantitative data with ecosystem feedback to guide iteration and future investment.

 Communicate product direction, decisions, tradeoffs, and release implications clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Improve how product decisions are made and documented as Morpho and its protocol ecosystem scale.

  
 What Success Looks Like
 First 30 days
 You understand Morpho's protocol, development and release process, current roadmap, and the rationale behind the major initiatives in flight. You have built relationships across protocol, engineering, research, security, and go-to-market teams, and have started speaking with key curators, distributors, integrators, and developers.
  
 First 3 months
 You have established a clear, prioritized view of the most important protocol problems and opportunities. The roadmap reflects explicit tradeoffs, user evidence, technical constraints, and measurable outcomes. You have driven at least one meaningful initiative from discovery into execution and proactively keep stakeholders aligned on decisions and changes.
  
 First 6 months
 You have shipped a meaningful protocol improvement and can show how it advanced user or business outcomes. Product, protocol, and engineering teams have stronger shared context on what to build and why. You consistently identify important user needs, ecosystem shifts, and roadmap conflicts early, and have improved Morpho's product discovery and decision-making process.

jobs.description:
Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution. 

 You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions. 

 We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering. 

 The role 

 Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams , working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

 Process ownership 

 You will own and continuously improve:

 French and Russian are nice to have.

jobs.title: Langfuse - Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Why this role exists 
 Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.
 Since being acquired by ClickHouse, with access to ClickHouse's broader GTM resources, Langfuse now has a growing enterprise motion and a large self-hosted user base.
 This role exists to give Langfuse a clear, accurate narrative that is easier to understand and adopt.
  
 How The Role Works 
 This role is for a product marketer who likes technical depth. A technical background is a strong plus, you should be technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility with engineers, and spot vague or misleading marketing.
 You'll become a true power user of Langfuse, and gain a front-row seat into how the best AI teams build production applications.
 You should expect close working relationships with both Langfuse teams and ClickHouse’s product marketing, sales and regional GTM teams.
  
 What we're looking for 
 Substantial experience in product marketing, product, or a technical role, including time spent on industry or vertical marketing.

 Past track record of crafting compelling messaging, positioning, and value propositions that resonate with developers, technical buyers, AI teams, enterprise stakeholders, and other highly technical audiences.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely.

 You have a technical background and an analytical mindset with the capacity to leverage data and metrics to measure performance in open-source PLG funnels and inform decision-making.

 Cross-functional collaborator comfortable working with stakeholders across functions and levels.

 A strong plus if you have a background in dev tools, open source, observability, or data/cloud infra. and/or if you have an existing public content or writing presence.

  
 What you'll do 
 Build messaging, positioning, and value props that work for developers, technical buyers, and enterprise stakeholders alike

 Own the category narrative (LLM observability, evals, prompt management, agent observability, self-hosting)

 Create sales enablement and marketing collateral and assets, including website content, blogs, webinars and presentations, launch narratives, and more

 Conduct competitive analysis to understand market trends, identify opportunities, and inform product and marketing strategies

 Evaluate and iterate on strategies with metrics and feedback from stakeholders to track efficacy, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven recommendations

 Lead product and feature launches, and spend time with users, customers, prospects, sales, support, and community members.

  
 Perks 
 Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

 Culture - We All Shape It
 As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.
 Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.
 Equal Opportunity & Privacy

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. 

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! 
 We're looking for people with software engineering backgrounds who are ready to move into technical project management, owning the business systems work behind our transition from a legacy stack to a new one. These are growth paths, not fully-formed PM seats.
 Our legacy stack involves over 100 systems across the globe including proprietary invoicing/billing/scheduling systems, two Salesforce instances and NetSuite, among others. Our new stack is HubSpot, Metronome, Stripe, NetSuite, and Workato. Getting from one to the other — while the business keeps running on both — is the core challenge of both tracks.
 We're hiring two people into this role. The skills profile is similar for both, but each hire will own one of two distinct tracks: O2C Integrations or CRM Projects . These tracks will eventually mature into a larger scope of internal tooling and enterprise customization. Track assignment will be based on candidate strengths and interest during onboarding, rather than decided in advance.
 
 
 Track 1: Order-to-Cash Integrations Projects 
 Focused on building and connecting 
 Own the Order-to-Cash flow end-to-end — Across both tech stacks. You're accountable for how orders, invoicing, billing, and revenue data move through the business, regardless of which systems they touch.

 Set integration ecosystem strategy — Define how integrations across business systems should be architected as a whole: point-to-point vs. centralized (e.g., via Workato), reusable patterns, and standards for how new systems connect in.

 Co-build the Legacy system replacement s— Partner with the Enterprise product team as technical owner of how the new platform's O2C integration layer is architected, including data models and API contracts.

 Control integration vendors — Own technical evaluation, SLAs, and build-vs-buy decisions for integration tooling and vendors across the ecosystem.

 Bridge legacy and new-stack engineering teams — Be the technical point of contact ensuring O2C data contracts and dependencies are understood on both sides.

 
 Track 2: CRM & Martech Projects 
 Focused on retiring and migrating CRM systems 
 Lead the Salesforce 2A sunset project — Own the plan, timeline, and execution for retiring this legacy Salesforce instance, coordinating data migration and cutover with dependent teams.

 Lead the Salesforce STAR sunset project — Same ownership model, applied to the STAR instance.

 Control the HubSpot vendor relationship — Own vendor management for HubSpot, including contract terms, SLA performance, and roadmap alignment with vendor capabilities.

 Own marketing automations — Own the roadmap and execution for marketing automation workflows (built largely on HubSpot). Campaign strategy sits with Marketing; you own the tooling and execution layer those campaigns run on.

 Manage sunset risk — Identify what breaks if a legacy system goes away too early, and build technically sound mitigation and rollback plans.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Software engineering background — you've built, maintained, or integrated production systems, ideally including APIs, middleware, or data pipelines.

 Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders alike.

 Detail oriented and structured approach — planning and running complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects to completion, including sequencing, risk management, and timeline ownership.

 Comfortable reading and reasoning about system architecture and data models across multiple connected systems without translation from engineering.

 Comfortable with ambiguity, especially around evolving scope boundaries between adjacent teams during a platform migration.

 
 Nice to Have 
 Familiarity with billing/invoicing/CRM systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, HubSpot, Stripe, Metronome, Workato, or similar).

 Experience with vendor management, including contract and SLA negotiation.

 Background in a company undergoing a legacy-to-modern platform migration.

 Experience defining integration strategy or standards at an organizational level, not just shipping individual integrations; exposure to integration architecture patterns (point-to-point, iPaaS/middleware, event-driven).

 Formal project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) — helpful but not required with structured ways of working

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. 

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Platform team in an internal-facing role focused on delivery excellence. You'll be the connective tissue across product teams — enabling fast, informed decision-making, keeping engineering delivery on track day-to-day, making sure our platform holds up to country-specific regulatory requirements as we scale globally and defining requirements for the platform back office.
 Alongside the day-to-day delivery work, you'll run a set of platform-wide programs: centralizing consent management and interfacing with the GTM team. This role is less about owning a single customer-facing roadmap and more about being the operational and program backbone that keeps cross-functional delivery moving smoothly and compliantly.
 
 What You'll Do
 Delivery & Coordination 
 Liaise with Group Product Managers (GPMs) — Act as a key point of coordination across product fault lines, surfacing decisions that need to be made and driving them to quick, well-informed resolution.

 Lead daily ceremonies — Run stand-ups and other recurring delivery ceremonies with engineering, keeping teams aligned on priorities, blockers, and progress.

 Troubleshoot with engineering — Partner directly with engineering leads to unblock delivery issues in real time, digging into technical details as needed.

 Lead triage for cross-cutting bugs and defects — Own the process for identifying, prioritizing, and assigning ownership of issues that span multiple product areas or teams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

 Drive process improvement — Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks or compliance gaps and put in place scalable processes to prevent them.

 Platform Delivery (Program) 
 Country-specific requirements — Own the platform-wide program ensuring the platform meets country-specific regulatory and functional requirements (e.g., GDPR and other regional regulations) consistently as we scale globally.

 Centralize consent management — Lead the program to consolidate consent management (data processing, marketing, cookie consent, etc.) into a single, consistent framework across the platform, replacing fragmented per-product implementations.

 Build the platform back office for technical support .

 
 What We're Looking For
 6+ years of product management experience, including experience in platform or delivery-focused roles.

 Proven ability to work across multiple teams and stakeholders to drive decisions quickly, especially in ambiguous or contested situations.

 Strong operational rigor — comfortable running ceremonies, triage processes, and cross-team workflows, alongside running longer-running platform programs and owning a live product.

 Experience working closely with engineering on troubleshooting and delivery issues; technical fluency is important.

 Experience owning a partner-facing or multi-market product, with sensitivity to regional variation across a large footprint (70 countries, in this case).

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders (including GPMs) without direct authority.

 A bias toward action and strong prioritization instincts in a fast-moving, cross-cutting role.

 
 Nice to Have
 Experience in a platform or infrastructure product role at a multi-market or global company.

 Background working with legal/compliance teams on regulatory rollouts, especially consent management programs.

 Experience setting up or scaling incident management, bug triage, or internal support tooling.

 Experience with franchise, partner, or multi-tenant portal products specifically.

 
 Why You Should Join 
 Most internal-facing delivery roles are pure coordination — you keep other people's things moving and own nothing yourself. This one comes with real roadmap and experience decisions for making a platform product portfolio truly global. Sitting across all the GPMs gives you genuine organizational leverage and visibility into the whole product landscape, which builds the kind of cross-functional credibility that prepares you for future leadership roles. You'll also get to build things properly rather than patch them: centralized consent management is greenfield, replacing fragmented per-product implementations that most people inherit and spend years apologizing for.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!
 
 The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 
 
 While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.
 
 This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
 Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
 Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
 Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
 Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
 Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
 Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
 Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
 Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
 Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
 Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
 Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
 Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
 Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

A career driven by you. Join AutoScout24 Group and experience life in the fast lane. We’re not just leading the market; we’re creating it. We’re constantly innovating, evolving and transforming things for our customers. We’re driven, ambitious and determined to do our best work, together. For a career that doesn’t stand still, where you can put your ideas in the driving seat and change the way the world moves, join our international community. 

As Team Lead Product Manager - Mobile Apps, you will own the vision and strategy for AutoScout24’s mobile app experience across iOS and Android. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Commercial teams to ensure we build intentionally for mobile, not simply adapt web experiences to the app. You will bring strong mobile product expertise, using data, experimentation, and native app capabilities to improve engagement, retention, and the overall customer experience.

What you’ll do:

Mobile Product Strategy

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AutoScout24’s mobile app experience
  • Drive mobile-first thinking across product teams and identify opportunities unique to app users.
  • Set clear goals, success metrics, and KPIs for engagement, retention, and customer experience.

Cross-Product Leadership

  • Partner with Product Managers across different customer journeys to translate customer problems into mobile-native solutions.
  • Influence teams without direct ownership, bringing strong mobile expertise and challenging web-first assumptions.
  • Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, and Commercial stakeholders around mobile priorities.

Product Discovery & Delivery

  • Use customer insights, data, experimentation, and market understanding to identify and validate opportunities.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
  • Drive initiatives from discovery through delivery, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Customer & Data Focus

  • Deeply understand mobile customer behaviour, needs, and pain points.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative insights to guide decisions.
  • Continuously monitor performance and improve key product metrics.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with strong experience building consumer mobile apps at scale.
  • Proven experience shaping mobile product strategy and delivering meaningful improvements in engagement, retention, or customer experience.
  • Experience influencing across multiple product teams and working closely with Engineering, Design, and Data.

Skills

  • Strong strategic thinking with a clear point of view on how mobile experiences should differ from web.
  • Deep understanding of mobile user behaviour, native app capabilities, engagement, and app growth.
  • Strong analytical skills, including product analytics, experimentation, and KPI ownership.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong business judgement and the ability to balance customer and commercial outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or other consumer digital products.
  • Experience with personalization, monetization, subscriptions, or growth products.
  • Familiarity with outcome-driven product management and modern discovery practices.

A culture of growth  

With over 50 nationalities represented, we’re proud to welcome people of all backgrounds to our growing community, and we’re always finding new ways to help people feel welcomed and included. Here, you’ll have the tools, training and support you need to work in a way that suits you, learn new skills and reach your potential.  

For a career where you can drive our business and shape your future, apply now.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Userlane Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally. Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications. 

 Your mission Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as: 
 Defining metrics that hold up : Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete. 

 Delivering outcome-linked metrics : Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on 

 Building for time-poor executives : Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?" 

 Connecting fragmented data sources : Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems, 

 Transforming insights into action : Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once 

 AI adoption governance : Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI. 

 

 

 Your profile 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation 

 You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't. 

 You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?" 

 You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does. 

 You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight 

 You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus 

 You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product 

 You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike 

 You're fluent in English (spoken and written) 
 

 

 What's in for you Team & Culture : A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries 

 Impact:  You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems 

 Product strategy influence : Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors 

 Market : Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry 

 Growth : We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training 
 Benefits : We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure

jobs.description:

 We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.
 Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. 
 Are you ready to join us?
 We are looking for a passionate and motivated Product Manager Apprentice to join our Customer Journey Team as part of the Checkout Squad.
  
 This apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to improve our shopping funnel on web and app, ensuring it’s as seamless and delightful an experience as possible. You will do so by helping to run AB tests on the user interface to uncover the most impactful features.
  
 You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including other Product Managers in the customer teams, Operations, Engineering, Content and Design, to drive impactful product initiatives.
 
 YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇 
 Support Product Development : Participate across the product lifecycle: solution ideation, prioritization, development, and launch.

 Handle Delivery Management : Write detailed specifications and user stories, oversee the implementation of features with IT engineers and perform quality assurance (QA).

 Autonomously run AB tests to optimize the conversion rate from product page to checkout. Scope the test, analyse and interpret the results to uncover the best solutions.

 Collaborate with Teams : Work closely with PMs, designers and marketing to challenge and prioritize feature requests, ensuring that our features are adopted seamlessly and add value to users (customers, sellers).

 Monitor performances: Ensure each feature’s performance can be measured, help estimate the impact and follow up the results post-launch.

 
 TOOLS YOU'LL USE: ⚒️
 Jira & Confluence: For Delivery management and Documentation

 Slack & Google Suite: For internal communications and meetings

 Amplitude Experiment and Analysis: for AB test setup and data analysis
 

 YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐
 You have an interest in product management and always put the user at the center of your thoughts.

 You have great analytical skills and a methodological approach.

 You possess effective and precise communication skills.

 You are curious, proactive, resourceful, and rigorous

 Team spirit is essential for you.

 You are fluent in spoken and written English, as we are an international team (MANDATORY).

 Big plus if you are already familiar with working with software developers, working across multiple teams or Agile concepts

 Big plus if you already have any experience in UX (user experience) or AB testing

 Starting date: January 2027

 Duration: Ideally for 24 months (12 months to be discussed). 

 Location: Paris, France

 Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

 
 RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅
 Product Sense Interview with Hiring Manager

 Team/Cultural fit interview with 1 other member of the team

 WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼 
 At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).
 No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

 Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

 The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
 GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

 What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
 You are technical enough to argue with engineers. 
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
 You can write. 
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
 You write specs worth acting on. 
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
 You know what looks good. 
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
 You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. 
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
 You want to be coached hard. 
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
 You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. 
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
 You want the scope to grow. 
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

 What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. 
 Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
 Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
 Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
 Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
 Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients
 
 What you'll be scoping over your first year: 
 Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
 Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
 AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
 Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
 You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.

 Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
 Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
 Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
 Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background
 Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
 Notion fluency
 
 Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.

 How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.
 Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
 Interview with the PM, including a brief intro

jobs.description:
About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. 

 Hybrid by design:  
 We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Agentic Discovery 
 About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.
 Job Summary We're looking for a systems-minded, AI-native Staff Product Manager to help lead the next chapter of Constructor: Agentic Discovery. As commerce shifts toward agentic experiences, we're investing heavily in a portfolio of AI-powered surfaces — our AI Shopping Assistant, Product Insights Agent, Prism recommendations, and more to come — that change how shoppers discover products and how businesses run discovery.
 This is a high-leverage, high-ambiguity role. You'll own two things at once: helping our agentic experiences scale from promising experiments into a repeatable, reliable engine, and giving the business teams who depend on them the same transparency and control over agentic experiences that they have today over traditional search.

This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.
 Agentic discovery at Constructor is fundamentally an AI and machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes it. You'll partner closely with ML, engineering, design, and go-to-market to turn new agentic capabilities into experiences that ship, prove value, and stay under our customers' control — and serve as the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams behind one coherent vision for agentic discovery.
