jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - DevEx
jobs.description:
Our mission

 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

 How you'll help us achieve it 

 Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

 AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

 The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

 
 Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.

 Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.

 Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.

 Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.

 Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.

 Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.

 Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

 
 In this role, you'll... 

 
 Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.

 Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. 

 Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.

 Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.

 Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.

 Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.

 Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

 
 Key Details 

 
 This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso

 Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.

 Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.

 Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.

 Major benefits:

 
 Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).

 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.

 Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 

 $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

 Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.

 Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.

 Speak fluent English

jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
jobs.description:
Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”
 
Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. 

 Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
 TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
 DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
 BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
 COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
 USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.
 

 What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
 Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
 Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
 Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
 Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
 Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
 Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
 Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
 Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.
 

 Meet us! 

 10 reasons to choose baramundi! #1 ARRIVE IN PEACE 
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

 #2 FEEL AT HOME 
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

 #3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION 
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

 #4 GET REWARDED 
You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

 #5 ENJOY LIFE 
Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible work

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. 

 Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. 

 At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

 As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

 As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
 You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
 You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
 You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
 You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
 You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. 
 You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. 
 

 Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
 Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
 Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. 
 Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. 
 Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. 
 Business fluency in both  English and German  is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.  
 

 What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible:  We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. 

 Room to grow // Stay curious:  In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. 

 Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active:  We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. 

 Taking responsibility // We #care:  We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis.

 We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us.

 Tasks

 What You'll Do

 
 Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks.

 Analyze business requirements and break them down into roadmaps, timelines, epics, tickets and tasks — and defend the cut list.

 Document, analyze and improve the whole user journey on both sides of the marketplace: candidates and employers have competing interests, and those trade-offs are yours to make rather than escalate.

 Create actionable concepts for new products and features, estimate effort and ROI, own the process from ideation to delivery.

 Decide where AI belongs and where it does not. Run experiments with the expected outcome written down first, then verify and iterate.

 Define KPIs, track them, improve them, revise them. Within 90 days we expect one metric you moved, with a baseline, a number, and a read you can defend to the leadership team.

 Collaborate with stakeholders, developers and the data team, and use data-driven storytelling to align them.

 
 Requirements

 Must have

 
 5+ years in Product Ownership/Management, shipping with cross-functional agile teams.

 Experience building or scaling marketplaces, job boards, or recruitment platforms — two-sided funnels behave differently and we would rather not teach that from scratch.

 Data-driven by default: you write your own analytics questions, read an experiment result, and say "this did not work" out loud. Analytics, A/B testing, experimentation.

 Strong ability to define product vision, roadmaps and priorities against business goals, customer needs and technical constraints — including clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for complicated workflows and funnels.

 Excellent written German and English. Our users, employers and support team are German-speaking; our codebase and documentation are English.

 
 Nice to have

 
 Search and SEO, including the AI-answer variants (AIEO, AEO, GEO) — a growing share of our traffic.

 Matching or recommendation systems: you know why offline metrics and business metrics disagree.

 Healthcare hiring workflows and empathy for the field — shift work, qualification recognition, and why a nurse does not read email at 14:00.

 SQL. Not required, but the people who enjoy this role usually have it.

 
 Benefits

 
 Decision authority. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths are not a slogan here: you will not need a committee to ship, and you will not get to blame one either.

 Direct access to the data — our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics. You query it yourself instead of filing a ticket and waiting.

 Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front.

 Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership.

 An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere.

 Central Berlin office in a beautiful old building, plus flexible remote

jobs.title: Lead product manager (UK)
jobs.description:
🚀 About WRITER 
 WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.
 Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.
 
 📐 About this role 
 This is a chance to help shape the next chapter of WRITER's product at a moment when generative AI is redefining how work gets done. As senior staff product manager, you'll report directly to Wil Pong, VP of Product, and operate as a force-multiplier across the product organization — setting direction where it's unclear, aligning stakeholders, and making sure our most critical initiatives ship with excellence.
 
 You'll own ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces that span multiple product areas and teams, and you'll be equal parts strategist and operator. One moment you're shaping a multi-quarter roadmap; the next you're rolling up your sleeves to unblock execution. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer empathy, technical depth, and business judgment — and who is energized by turning complex, evolving AI capabilities into products customers love.

 Define and own success metrics for your areas, using data and qualitative signal to evaluate impact, course-correct, and tell the story of outcomes to leadership

 Senior- or staff-level experience operating autonomously across ambiguous, multi-team problem spaces and influencing outcomes well beyond your immediate team

 Technical credibility to engage meaningfully with engineers and researchers on system design, LLM capabilities, data, and architecture, knowing when to go deep and when to defer to the experts

 A blend of strong strategic thinking and relentless execution — you can set a compelling vision one moment and sweat the details of a release plan the next

 A mentor's instinct and a builder's drive, with the data-informed, outcome-driven mindset to define success up front and move with the speed this environment demands

 Experience building products powered by LLMs, generative AI, or large-scale AI/ML systems

 🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job description Who we are  
Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. Kranus Health is a digital therapeutics platform running in several countries across urology and gynecology. Our newest therapy, Kranus Mictera, treats urinary incontinence in women, a condition that affects one in three women and that almost no onetakes seriously. Our therapies are built together with leading clinicians and scientists, prescribed by doctors, and reimbursed by health insurers, whichmeans everything you ship reaches patients with a real diagnosis instead of a wellness audience. We are ~50 people, everyone here owns outcomes ratherthan tickets, and AI is a settled part of how we work, so you won't be stuck in 2022 tooling here. One platform, many therapies, 3 countries. Small team. Big impact. If you live and breathe change, you will feel at home here.

 The Role 
As our Product Manager in charge of our consumer-facing Digital Therapeutics, you will lead the way to transform our platform of therapies from good to first-class with taste. This is not a feature-shipping role. We want someone who thinks in user journeys, obsesses over behavior change, and can tell the difference between a product that works and one that genuinely moves patients forward.

 Your responsibilities Therapy ownership:  You own the full patient journey end-to-end – from the moment a doctor prescribes the therapy, through onboarding and the active therapy phase, to the point where patients feel a real difference and stay. AI is part of the work and part of the product – but it's a means to an end, not the goal itself. 
 Behavior & retention:  You apply proven knowledge of habit loops, nudges, feedback systems, and engagement mechanics to drive sustainable usage. 
 Mobile ownership: You own our therapy apps across urology and gynecology end-to-end.

 Analyse der wichtigsten Customer-, Candidate- und Operations-Prozesse inklusive ihrer System- und Datenflüsse

 Funnel-Analysen und Product Analytics als Grundlage für Entscheidungen

 Verantwortung für QA und Erfolgsmessung – vom erkannten Problem bis zum validierten Pilot in wenigen Wochen 

 
 Automatisierung & Skalierung 

 Übersetzung wiederkehrender manueller Abläufe in wiederverwendbare Prozesse, Automatisierungen und technische Komponenten 

 Praktischer Einsatz von LLMs, AI-Workflows, Low-Code-Tools und einfachen Skripten 

 Aufbau von Lösungen, die sich auf neue Märkte und akquirierte Unternehmen übertragen lassen, ohne jedes Mal neu gebaut zu werden 

 

 Das bringst du mit: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Technical Product Management, Product Operations, Solution Design oder einer vergleichbaren hands-on Produktrolle 

 Sicherheit in Prozessanalyse, Product Discovery, Prototyping, Short PRDs, Akzeptanzkriterien, QA und Erfolgsmessung 

 Technisches Verständnis von APIs, Datenmodellen, Integrationen, Systemlogik und Architektur-Trade-offs

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join a winning Team 
 EngagedMD is a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.
 We embrace a mission-driven culture where committed individuals come together to make a real impact in healthcare. Join us today in our mission to help carers carry on caring.
 You are an innovative and driven product leader looking to chart a path forward for a suite of healthtech products. We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution used nationwide and internationally by over 3 million users since its launch and continues to see enormous growth and adoption from medical clinics across multiple markets. This is an exciting opportunity to join a small and growing team, and to be both strategic and hands-on. You will have the opportunity to set, share, and gain buy-in for the vision for our products, while also closely collaborating with our engineering, sales, customer success, marketing, finance and operations teams. As part of this role, you will be actively leveraging AI on a daily basis to drive roadmap investment decisions and feature direction. 
 You’ll also have the opportunity to lead and grow a product team. You’ll be responsible for finding and executing on opportunities to grow and enhance our suite of products. You’ll collaborate with other leaders to manage the software release process while influencing both on-shore and off-shore engineering teams to pursue best-in-class customer experiences for the medical professionals and patients that use our system.  
 This fully remote role reports to our VP, Product, and candidates are required to reside in the United States. This role requires legal authorization to work in the United States. EngagedMD is unable to sponsor current H1B visa holders for this role.
  
 What You’ll Do 
 Collaborate with other Product leaders to help define and share our overall product vision, including contributing to and prioritizing EngagedMD’s product roadmap

 Leverage AI to design and prototype new features

 Leverage data to inform investment decisions and drive feature impact.

 Commercialize new features and product lines in support of revenue growth goals

 Collaborate across Engineering and Design functions to enhance product functionality.

 Lead and execute the user feedback lifecycle process

 Manage product integrations with other health tech companies and electronic medical record (EMR) partners

 Lead, grow, and develop a high-performing product management team  

 

 What You’ll Bring 
 At least 8 years of industry experience, including at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally in healthtech or other SaaS

 Demonstrated prior success as a high-performing product manager or group product manager

 Hands on experience with AI-driven software development, including vibe coding, UI design, and prototyping

 Proven track record of delivering customer-first, data-driven products and driving roadmap strategy and investment decisions

 Strong technical fluency in web-based applications, APIs (REST), databases (SQL), and code repository version control software 

 Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders

 Excellent relationship-building capacity and ability to influence at all levels across the organization, as well as customers and partners 

 Experience building teams with a passion for providing mentorship, coaching, and development of the team

 An ability to model EngagedMD’s core values and action principles

 Prior successful experience working remotely with globally distributed teams  

 A mission-driven orientation to all you do 

 Superior written and verbal communication skills

 Ability to thrive in a small, fast-paced organization 

 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent career experience 

  
 It’s Also Nice If You… 
 Experience working in the healthcare technology industry

  
 What We Offer 
 Competitive compensation and equity

 Medical, dental, and vision coverage heavily subsidized by the company

 Open Paid Time Off

 Paid family and medical leave

 Generous paid holidays

 401(k) retirement savings plan 

  
 EngagedMD is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe our company and products are made better by the varied perspectives of our employees, each of whom we seek to empower and support in their individuality. We hire our team members on the basis of merit, qualifications, and the needs of our business in order to best achieve our mission to make life easier for the clinics and patients we serve.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.
